models_evaluated: dual-stage convolutional neural network for kidney stone detection

links.outcome: Prospective forward-in-time performance of the model outside routine clinical operations
links.effect: Over six months, three radiologists annotated 5,152 slices; the model achieved 97.83% accuracy, 94.64% sensitivity, 98.27% specificity, 88.50% precision, and kappa 0.90.
links.quote: The pilot deployment demonstrated strong diagnostic performance under real-world variability, achieving 97.83% accuracy, 94.64% sensitivity, 98.27% specificity, 88.50% precision, and a Cohen's kappa of 0.90.

screen.reason: Evaluates a deep learning model for kidney stone detection on CT in a simulated prospective web-based workflow platform with radiologists, but does not compare or test specific guardrails or deployment practices against an alternative.
